svg.text: Primary object: Current manga page and its editable text Regions
Impression: attentive · precise · quiet · Tempo: Careful page-by-page proofreading with short, nonblocking machine-assist intervals
画布优先 · 稳定属性栏
Character · A calm three-column proof desk: compact rails frame a
large dark pasteboard and the Inspector reads as a measured editorial
Subject · The reading rhythm follows paper, margin, and annotation:
the page is centered, regions are editorial marks, and metadata aligns
Signature · A thin vertical proof rule links the selected page
thumbnail, Region 08 outline, and the Inspector header without drawing
Risk · The Light theme retains a deep neutral pasteboard around the
white manga page instead of whitening the whole editor.
画布优先 · 上下文属性抽屉
Character · A broad visual stage with a precise right-anchored
annotation drawer, letting the page breathe until a Region asks for
Subject · A selected speech region produces an editorial side note:
the drawer is attached by proximity and state, not by a decorative
Signature · The drawer header repeats the selected Region's small
cropped paper fragment as a location chip, making context recoverable
Risk · The warm annotation layer creates a second material temperature
校对优先 · 文本与画布分栏
Character · A deliberate reading spread: a proof sheet establishes
text order on the left while the page remains the visual authority on
Subject · The composition borrows the act of comparing a printed proof
against a page: reading order, source text, and result line up as
Signature · A selected proof row has a narrow vertical registration
mark that aligns with the matching Region's edge on the page.
Risk · The proof sheet is intentionally prominent enough to support
careful reading rather than a conventional hidden Inspector.
